name: Full-scan aggregation
why: Count every record grouped by level. No index helps; this is raw scan throughput over the whole corpus. Was 'not expressible' against PulseTrace until the query engine shipped — note the two sides bound the window differently: OpenObserve is given an explicit 48h range, PulseTrace aggregates the whole index, which holds only this corpus.

body.sql: SELECT level, count(*) AS n FROM logs GROUP BY level ORDER BY n DESC

query.sql: SELECT level, count(*) AS n FROM bench_logs GROUP BY level ORDER BY n DESC
